text: A handful of wool is mostly air.
A felting needle changes that. Its tiny barbs catch a few fibres on every poke, and drag them in, where they tangle and stay.
asr: A felting needle changes that. Its tiny barbs catch a few fibers on every poke, and drag them in, where they tangle and stay.

text: Forty pokes, and the cloud is a ball. Four hundred, and it holds its shape.
A second ball becomes a head. A cone becomes a beak. The wings are flat layers, pressed on.
Colour goes in the same way. Where two shades meet, the needle blends them, and there is no edge.
asr: Color goes in the same way. Where two shades meet, the needle blends them, and there is no edge.

text: Four thousand pokes. And what was air is looking back.
asr: 4,000 pokes. And what was air is looking back.
